about: Song sections corrected from their chord sheets, approved by the maintainer 2026-10-24 (T428), and from their raw chord lines 2026-10-25 (T432). Chords are as each sheet writes them (capo shapes where the sheet uses a capo; the numerals are the same). `npm run chords -- respell` spells every song from these where given, and from the shipped credits otherwise, by AC-2.6.1/19. A song listed here has all its credits taken from here. The songs added 2026-10-25 are written from their shipped numerals in C, with the held chord the sheet shows, since only the held chord was in question.
